fitzgerald_teacher.text: Welcome in. I teach at the scoil, which is the school. A madra is a dog, and a cat is a cat, because the cats never learned Irish.
In the spring the Polartern nests on the shore. It is an Arctic tern, flying pole to pole each year. Do not wave near a nest, it will dive at you.
Dingle is in the Gaeltacht, where Irish is the everyday language. The Irish lessons come free with the weather.
